en.title: Adverbs of time
en.summary: Adverbs of time tell when something happens.

paragraphs: Adverbs of time tell when something happens, or for how long. They answer the question when? Some give a point in time (today, tomorrow), some show a stage (already, yet, still) and some show the order of events (first, then, later).

Adverbs of time usually go at the end or at the beginning of the sentence. Already goes before the main verb or at the end, and yet goes at the end of questions and negatives. Still goes before the main verb, but after be. Use the beginning for emphasis, with a comma if it is long.

blocks.html:
AdverbPlaceExample
tomorrow, todayendI'll go tomorrow.
alreadybefore the main verbShe has already left.
yetendHas he come yet?
stillbefore the main verbHe still lives here.
then, laterstart or endLater we ate.

paragraphs: Already shows that something happened earlier than expected. Yet asks or says that something expected has not happened. Still shows that something continues. Compare She has already gone, She hasn't gone yet, She is still here.
Ago counts back from now: three days ago. Before counts back from a time in the past: three days before. We say I met him two years ago, but I had met him two years before.

items: Wrong: **I already have eaten.** Right: **I have already eaten.**
Wrong: **Has he already come?** (a simple question) Right: **Has he come yet?**
Wrong: **I have seen him since two days.** Right: **I saw him two days ago.**

ro.title: Adverbe de timp
ro.summary: Adverbele de timp arată când are loc o acțiune și nu își schimbă niciodată forma.

paragraphs: Adverbele de timp arată momentul unei acțiuni. Ele răspund la întrebarea „când?”. Aceste cuvinte nu își schimbă forma după gen sau număr.

În limba română, adverbele de timp stau des la începutul sau la sfârșitul propoziției. Unele adverbe scurte pot sta direct lângă verb. De exemplu, adverbul „deja” stă adesea lângă verb. Forma adverbului rămâne mereu aceeași.

blocks.html:
AdverbPoziție obișnuităExemplu
acumla început sau la sfârșit**Acum** citesc o carte.
mâinela sfârșit sau la începutPlecăm **mâine** la mare.
dejalângă verbAm terminat **deja** tema.
încădupă negație sau verbNu a venit **încă** trenul.
ierila început sau la sfârșit**Ieri** am fost ocupat.
